contexts.text: The expiation or propitiation of the Lord is protection from the inundation of evil.

Thou shalt make a propitiatory (or mercy-seat) of pure gold () = the hearing and reception of all things of worship from the good of love. The propitiatory = the cleansing from evils, or the remission of sins, consequently, the hearing and reception of all things which are of worship. That the propitiatory = the cleansing from evils and the remission of sins, is evident from the places in the Word where propitiation or expiation is mentioned; and that it = the reception of all things of worship, is because those who have been propitiated or expiated, that is, cleansed from evils, are alone heard... and therefore Aaron was not allowed to approach the propitiatory until he had cleansed and expiated himself and the people.
(Moreover) Jehovah spoke with Moses upon the propitiatory between the cherubs. TCR 283:2.
Therefore there were cherubs upon the propitiatory...
(Therefore) the propitiatory was upon the ark, and the cherubs were upon the propitiatory; and the propitiatory and cherubs were of pure gold. AE 392:5.
That the propitiatory = a cleansing from evils, thus the remission of sins. Illustrated.
The propitiatory = the hearing and reception of all the things of worship which are from the good of love. AC 9517. AC 9518. AC 9682. AC 10196. AC 10339. AE 277:4. AE 283:14. AE 700:3.
Expiation, propitiation, and redemption, are nothing else than purification from evils and falsities, the implantation of good and truth, and their conjunction; thus regeneration. References.

A bullock of sin thou shalt offer... upon the propitiations ()... The propitiations = the reception of the good of love and of faith from the Lord after the removal of evils and the derivative falsities.

In propitiating thyself upon it () = the faculty of receiving good from the Lord; (for) to propitiate upon the altar = after the removal of evils and the derivative falsities, the implantation of good by the Lord, and the reception of it by man and Angel.

Seven days thou shalt propitiate upon the altar () = what is full as to the influx into Heaven and the Church... To propitiate = purification from evils and the derivative falsities. AC 10127:4, Explained.
As to propitiate and expiate = this, they also involve the implantation of good and truth, and the conjunction of both by the Lord. Explained.
Be propitious to our iniquity () = that their interiors may be removed. Explained.
That the Lord was propitious. Signified.
Propitiation lest the Angels of the Spiritual Kingdom should be hurt... Signified, Explained.
Propitiations in the Israelitish Church were made by incensings. In like manner here, lest they should be hurt by the satanic Spirits...
That I might speak with them... about mediation, intercession, propitiation, and expiation. (Explained.)
This Human is what propitiates, etc.

Propitiation means the operation of clemency and grace, lest man by sins should bring himself into condemnation; likewise protection, lest he should profane holiness. This was signified by the propitiatory...
That the Testimony = the Lord, is evident from the fact that that which was upon the ark was called the propitiatory, and the Lord is the Propitiator.
By this was represented that all propitiation and expiation were from the Lord's Divine love.
By the propitiatory is signified the removal of the Falsities from evil loves, and, then, reception and hearing.
That (the present faith) is propitiation, namely the propitiation of God the Father by... the blood of His Son. Explained. AE 806:2. AE 810:3.
Upon which is the propitiatory, which is the Lord.
